about: A reply's [title](button:<id>) links as text (docs/protocol.md, "Reply buttons"). op unlink: every button link whose id isn't in known left as its words (a button the thread doesn't keep, an older runner's row, another thread's), others untouched; the desktop app (desktop/core/src/reply_buttons.rs unlink), the iPhone and Android (ReplyButtons.unlinking). op trailing: the button links ending a line peeled off to be drawn as buttons after its words, with what's left of the line; only the phones (ReplyButtons.trailing). The website draws button links as it renders the markdown (web/src/App.tsx buttonFor), with no text pass to test here.

cases.name: a button the row carries stays a link, one it doesn't is its title
with no buttons known every button link is its title
text with no button links is left alone
words with brackets in them are minded

input.text: Do it [Go](button:known123) or [Old one](button:gone4567), see [a [b] c](button:gone4567). [site](https://x.y)

expect.text: Do it [Go](button:known123) or Old one, see a [b] c. [site](https://x.y)

differs.ios: Its regex takes no brackets inside a link's words, so a button it doesn't keep whose words have [brackets] stays a link (one that does nothing when tapped); the desktop app minds them.
differs.android: Its regex takes no brackets inside a link's words, so a button it doesn't keep whose words have [brackets] stays a link (one that does nothing when tapped); the desktop app minds them.

cases.name: buttons at the end of a line are peeled off

input.text: The Pebble form is due Friday. [Fill in the form](button:abcd1234) · [Not now](button:efgh5678)

expect.text: The Pebble form is due Friday.

differs.desktop: The desktop app draws a pill where its link is in the line; the phones peel the ones ending a line off to draw as buttons after its words.
